_comment: Golden parity fixtures for tool retrieval (knaif.registry.retrieve_tools / knaif_core::retrieve_tools). Consumed by BOTH python/core/tests/test_retrieval_parity.py and native/crates/knaif-core/tests/retrieval_parity.rs. `expected_ranked` is ORDER-SENSITIVE: Python emits retrieved tools in relevance order and build_prompt lists them in that order, so a set-equal but differently ordered result is a different prompt. `expected_always_include` is a SET on purpose - Python appends those by iterating a frozenset, whose order is not a guaranteed contract, and build_prompt filters them out before they reach the model anyway. Registries are inline tools.yaml text so parity does not depend on skill content. Regenerate with scripts in the parity plan; expected values come from the Python reference implementation, never hand-written.

registries.retrieval_demo:
trim_video:
  description: Trim a video to a time range
  keywords: [trim, cut, shorten]
  required_args: [input]
  optional_args: [start, end, output]
resize_video:
  description: Resize a video to a target height
  keywords: [resize, scale, downscale]
  required_args: [inputs]
  optional_args: [height, output]
compress_video:
  description: Compress a video to reduce file size
  keywords: [compress, smaller, shrink]
  required_args: [inputs]
  optional_args: [quality, output]
convert_video:
  description: Convert a video container or codec
  keywords: [convert, transcode]
  required_args: [inputs]
  optional_args: [container, output]
strip_audio:
  description: Remove the audio track from a video
  keywords: [mute, silent, strip]
  required_args: [inputs]
  optional_args: [output]
alpha_tool:
  description: Shared keyword tie candidate alpha
  keywords: [tiebreak]
  required_args: [inputs]
beta_tool:
  description: Shared keyword tie candidate beta
  keywords: [tiebreak]
  required_args: [inputs]
gamma_tool:
  description: Shared keyword tie candidate gamma
  keywords: [tiebreak]
  required_args: [inputs]
internal_helper:
  description: Never surfaced to the model
  keywords: [trim, resize, compress]
  required_args: [inputs]
  internal: true
clarify:
  description: Ask the user a question
  required_args: [question]
reject:
  description: Refuse the request
  required_args: [reason]
done:
  description: Signal completion
  required_args: []
